layout.filtered: Configured cards only; retain fixed card widths and left alignment while filtering. Editing clears/disables filters and exposes all groups.
layout.drawer: Native modal; width:min(600px,100vw); height:100dvh; backdrop:#0008; independent vertical content scroll; background scroll locked; focus restored on dismissal.
layout.catalog: 34 built-in metrics plus server-registered assets; unified local/remote search with All, A-share, Hong Kong, US and Crypto chips. Chinese security names, Shanghai/Shenzhen/Beijing and HK codes, crypto names/tickers and common Chinese aliases are supported.
layout.settings: Native auto popover opened by gear left of Languages and Refresh: search, favorites, add/edit, color convention, card-width slider and data status. Command/Ctrl+K opens search; Escape/outside click dismisses.
layout.flow: Wrapping, left-aligned flex groups with 18px horizontal gap and 20px bottom spacing; cards wrap with 8px gaps and never grow to fill rows.

cardWidth.behavior: Fixed width clamped to available container width; slider in settings.

layout.persistence: v2 stores card layout, group order, row starts and width together; accepts v1 card layouts. Save/Cancel covers all editor changes; width changes outside editing save immediately.
layout.chrome: No top date, board title/count, bottom historical count or daily/latest collection summary. Active filters appear above groups. Collection-time watermark: fixed right 16px, bottom 10px, mono 11px, opacity .65; main bottom padding 40px.
layout.sorting: Pointer drag shows complete card/group overlay and makes room live; group bottom 24px target creates a new row. Escape cancels only current drag. Card/group arrows and group row toggle provide keyboard alternatives; edge scrolling supports long boards.
layout.language: Chinese/English switch via independent Languages icon. Settings/Languages/Refresh: 32px desktop, 34px phone, 6px gaps. Language key economic:language is independent of v2 layout. Translate UI, built-in names, sources, detail and charts; use provider English names where available and preserve symbols.
layout.cardNames: Reserve 44px right padding for card actions on desktop, 54px on phones; overflow-wrap:anywhere supports long names in either language.

narrative.overview:
A dark observation desk with calibrated charts, aligned measurements, and quiet dividing rules. Its modern, technical character comes from precise numeric typography and readable evidence, rather than decoration.

The interface supports Chinese and English. Chinese labels use the system CJK fallback beside locally bundled Latin fonts; switching language preserves the same visual hierarchy. Units and exceptional states remain visible on cards; observation dates and source notes are available in tooltips and detail views.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces with restrained lime selection and action accents.
Monospaced measurements paired with compact sans-serif labels.
Flat, ruled panels and responsive detail views.

rules.name: The Signed Change Rule
rules.body: Pair rise/fall color with a sign and unit; color alone never carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use the mono face for quantities and identifiers; retain the sans-serif stack for descriptive labels. Chart axes and tooltip text stay at 12px; compact card units and exceptional status labels use 10px. Observation dates appear in source tooltips and detail views.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate data regions with the existing tonal layers and thin rules before adding elevation.

dos: **Do** align quantities and use explicit units and signed changes; make observation dates available in tooltips and detail.
**Do** use lime consistently for selection, primary action, and chart emphasis.
**Do** preserve visible focus, modal dismissal and focus return to the invoking card.
**Do** show missing observations and source failures explicitly.
**Do** save or cancel all editor changes together and provide arrow/row-toggle alternatives to pointer dragging.
donts: **Don't** imply rise or fall through color alone.
**Don't** substitute invented chart points for absent observations.
**Don't** add decorative imagery or hero typography to the data workspace.
**Don't** hide latest values, units, changes, or exceptional status to make mobile cards fit.
**Don't** confuse filtering saved cards with searching the full catalog in the add-card picker.
**Don't** stretch cards to fill a row; preserve the chosen fixed width and left alignment.
